description: Airports in Colorado is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. Airport locations, nearby city, recreation in the area, and more with associated data (hours, annual number of passengers, etc) from the Colorado Department of Transportation (CDOT). Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are runway, airplane, bic, cdot, city. The table has 31 columns. Attribution on the portal: CDOT. The portal shows 2025-07-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
